title: fix(cart): keep discounts when a cart is merged

children.markdown: Signing in merges the guest cart into the saved one. [`mergeCarts`](review-source:head/src/cart/merge.ts#L8-L41) now carries the guest cart's discount codes across instead of dropping them.

review.verdict: **Ready after one fix.** Discounts survive the merge, but two codes for the same campaign now stack.

findings.body: Both carts can hold a code from the same campaign, and the merged cart keeps both, so the discount applies twice.
findings.why: Customers would pay less than the campaign allows; this is the one behaviour change in the PR that's wrong.

findings.body: The test names say "discount" where they mean "discount code".
findings.why: Wording only; renaming now costs a re-review for no behaviour change.

findings.body: **Say who sees the change.** The summary describes the code, not that signed-in shoppers now keep the codes they entered as guests.
findings.why: Reviewers outside the cart team read the first line to decide if they need to look; it's a judgment call how much to change.

change.proposed: Shoppers who enter a discount code as a guest now keep it after signing in.

held_out: The merge runs inside the sign-in transaction; checked, no change needed.
